neighbours.label: the verb of considering a course of action ('if you're considering', 'decide to give up', 'thinking of')
fire: A checkup is wise, especially if you're considering a long trip.
Before you decide to give up on running, read this.
Firms who want to bid on the job must sign up.
If you're considering a new car, be sure to compare prices.
Before you decide to walk away, call me.
Anyone who wants to apply for a permit should write.
If you're planning to move, be sure to check the schools.
A plan helps, especially if you're looking to save money.
quiet: A checkup is wise, especially if you're an older adult.
Before you eat the soup, read this.
Firms in the district must sign up.
If you're a new driver, be sure to carry papers.
Before you go to sleep, call me.
Anyone in the building should write.
If you're at the school, be sure to sign in.
A plan helps, especially if you're a young parent.
